Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1.  **No**, this is not the chat view with a PROJECT SHOWCASE card. This is the **home/landing page** of the portfolio.
2.  **No**, there is no user question bubble or assistant reply text visible. The only visible text in the input area is the placeholder: **"Ask me anything..."**.
3.  **Yes**, there is a faint circular ring/lens visible just below the chin of the avatar, which appears to be a cursor-following magnification effect.
4.  The background is **clean white** (with a very large, faint watermark of the name "Emon" at the bottom).
